description:
On October 18, 2025, Mark Scheifele etched his name atop the franchise record books, scoring his 813th career point to become the all-time points leader in Winnipeg Jets history. The milestone came on a power-play goal, as Scheifele ripped a one-timer to open the scoring in the game. Fittingly, Scheifele was the franchise’s first-ever draft pick after relocating from Atlanta, selected seventh overall in the 2011 NHL Draft. His achievement stands as a testament to his consistency, leadership, and lasting impact on the Jets organization.

description:
In his NHL debut, Sergei Fedorov immediately thrilled Detroit Red Wings fans by scoring his first career goal. During a power play on the road in New Jersey, Fedorov executed a beautiful give-and-go with Steve Yzerman before firing the puck into the back of the net. His goal was part of an impressive rookie campaign in which he registered 31 goals and 79 points. The former Hart Trophy and two-time Selke Trophy winner spent the first 13 of his 18 seasons with Detroit, where he won three Stanley Cup championships.

description:
Jake Guentzel just keeps doing what he does best. A near point-per-game force for a decade—both in the regular season and the playoffs—the elite winger put on another show against the New Jersey Devils, recording the 10th hat trick of his career. He opened the scoring early, then buried two more on the power play to complete the trio. A Stanley Cup champion and a key member of Team USA at the 4 Nations Face-Off, Guentzel continues to be a major impact player everywhere he goes.

description:
In his 14th NHL season—all spent with the Nashville Predators—Filip Forsberg delivered a clutch moment on home soil. Playing in the Global Series matchup in Sweden, the franchise’s all-time goals leader buried the game-tying goal with just over a minute left in regulation, forcing overtime against Pittsburgh. Nashville went on to win and secure the full two points. With the tally, Forsberg became the 12th Sweden-born player to score in an NHL regular-season game held in his home country.
